question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "symptoms."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"symptoms"** would fit in the blank.
 
• **"Symptoms"** means a change in your body that is a sign of illness. (रोग का चिह्न; लक्षण)
 
• The use of **"symptoms"** in the blank is important for specifying what the respondents are referring to when expressing their desire to know about Alzheimer's disease.
 
• This emphasizes that people would like to be informed about the presence of the disease, even before noticeable symptoms manifest.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph:

You may wonder if anyone would want__ to be diagnosed before they are even aware they have Alzheimer's __disease__? A recent survey shows that, indeed, they would. __Nearly__ three-quarters of the respondents said they would want __**to know**__ if they had Alzheimer’s disease, even if they were not yet experiencing __**symptoms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Marks: **spots or lines that spoil the appearance of something. (निशान या लकीर (जिससे किसी की शकल बिगड़ जाए))
 
• **Indexes: **ways of showing how the price, value, rate, etc. of something has changed. (क़ीमत, दर आदि में हुए परिवर्तन को दर्शाने का एक प्रकार या पद्घति; सूचकांक)
 
• **Evidences: **anything that can be used to prove something. (कुछ भी जिसका उपयोग किसी चीज़ को साबित करने के लिए किया जा सकता है)
